minutes.headline: Trust commission accuses school committee of illegally withholding scholarship fund records; dispute unresolved
minutes.summary: The Trust Funds Commission spent most of this meeting on its year-long dispute with the school committee over custody of scholarship and charitable trust accounts, with the chair reading a lengthy formal letter citing statutes and case law and requesting a joint meeting and document production. The commission also unanimously approved a rewritten warrant article on continuity of trust fund administration during a board vacancy and ratified prior minutes; no members of the public spoke.

what_happened.line: The Trust Funds Commission chair read a formal letter to the school committee, town manager, town counsel, treasurer and select board chair citing statutes and case law, over custody of scholarship and trust fund records.
The commission is weighing a complaint to the Board of Bar Overseers against the school committee's attorney if no joint meeting takes place.
Commissioners unanimously approved a rewritten warrant article on continuity of trust fund administration during a board vacancy, to go to the town meeting warrant.
The dispute remains unresolved; the commission is awaiting a joint meeting and document production from the school committee and other town officials.

why_it_matters: A dispute over who has legal custody of school scholarship and charitable trust accounts is unresolved, which affects how those donor-restricted funds are administered and reported.
A warrant article on trust fund governance during a board vacancy will go before town meeting, a vote residents may be asked to take.
If the dispute is not resolved through a joint meeting, the commission may pursue a bar complaint against the school committee's attorney, a step beyond current town-level discussion.
